testcase.name: Scenario: Dock and resize Appearance Browser on the right: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-docking-system-source/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:42:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dock and resize Appearance Browser on the right ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And Appearance Browser is floating over the workspace ✔ When the user drags the Appearance Browser title bar to the far right workspace edge ✔ Then Appearance Browser docks along the right edge ✔ And the Model Browser remains visible on the left ✔ And the viewport occupies the space between both browser panels ✔ And the active part document remains open ✔ When the user drags the shared boundary toward the viewport to widen Appearance Browser ✔ Then Appearance Browser becomes wider ✔ And the viewport becomes narrower ✔ And the view orientation control remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user restores the boundary to its earlier position ✔ Then the docked panel and viewport return to their earlier proportions
